repositories.description: The repositories the digest covers, each owner/repo, one section each in this order.

lookback_hours.description: The window the earlier GitHub reads already applied. Used for the headline; this skill does no time filtering of its own unless the reads cannot be told apart.

branch.description: The branch the commit read listed, for the headline. Default: the repository's default branch.

trigger_type.description: How the run started. manual returns the digest as a draft for review.

now.description: The run's current time, ISO 8601, for report.meta.generated_at. Optional: absent, the run start time stated in the instructions is used. Never guessed.
